target.title: fix(googlechat): cap approval binding registries
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes two unbounded in-process Maps in the Google Chat approval flow:

1. **`approvalCardBindings`** — maps `cardId → {messageId, spaceId, agentRunId}` for every in-flight approval card sent via native Google Chat interactive cards. No eviction path; on an instance with high approval-card throughput over a long-lived gateway this Map grows without limit.
2. **`manualApprovalFollowupSuppressions`** — tracks `{spaceId, agentRunId}` pairs to suppress duplicate follow-up text after native card delivery. Same unbounded growth pattern.

## Why This Change Was Made

Applies `pruneMapToMaxSize` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/collection-runtime` immediately after every `.set` call on both Maps, each capped at **1 024 entries** with LRU eviction. A cap of 1 024 comfortably covers simultaneous in-flight approval cards in any realistic deployment; an evicted binding simply cannot be resolved — the same behavior as a gateway restart.

**Diff:** 2 files, +83 lines (prod: +14, test: +69)

## User Impact

Operators running Google Chat channels with high approval-card volume on long-lived gateways get bounded memory for both registries. Behavior is unchanged for the first 1 024 simultaneous in-flight approval cards.

## Evidence

**Two new regression tests, both passing on `fix/googlechat-cap-approval-bindings`:**

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run \
    --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-messaging.config.ts \
    extensions/googlechat/src/approval-card-actions.test.ts \
    --reporter=verbose

 ✓ Google Chat approval card action registry > suppresses manual exec approval follow-up text for an active native card     20ms
 ✓ Google Chat approval card action registry > suppresses manual exec approval follow-up text after native delivery          0ms
 ✓ Google Chat approval card action registry > keeps unrelated, expired, and non-sendable approval text visible             0ms
 ✓ Google Chat approval card action registry > suppresses only text-only manual approval follow-up payloads                 0ms
 ✓ Google Chat approval card action registry > evicts oldest approval card bindings once the cache exceeds its cap          1ms
 ✓ Google Chat approval card action registry > evicts oldest manual approval follow-up suppressions once the cache exceeds its cap  1ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  6 passed (6)
   Duration  195ms
```
